content.json:
## Microsoft Teams
---

This workbook is dedicated to Microsoft Teams Logs.

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "MicrosoftTeams"
| summarize count() by  Operation, bin_at(TimeGenerated, 1h, now())
content.title: Operations Over Time

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "MicrosoftTeams"
| summarize count() by Operation , bin_at(TimeGenerated, 1h, now())
| summarize makelist(count_), sum(count_) by Operation
| order by sum_count_
content.title: Types of Operation

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "MicrosoftTeams"
| summarize  OperationCount = count() , ['Last Activity Time'] = arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by UserId, Operation
| project OperationCount,  UserId, Operation, ['Last Activity Time']
| order by OperationCount
content.title: Last Activity based on User

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where Operation contains "Added" or Operation contains "Removed" or Operation contains "Deleted" or Operation contains "Created"
| summarize count() by Operation

OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where Operation contains "Added" or Operation contains "Removed" or Operation contains "Deleted" or Operation contains "Created"
| project TimeGenerated, Operation, TeamName, ChannelName, UserId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc

OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where CommunicationType == "Team"
| where Operation == "MemberAdded"
| extend DisplayName_ = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].DisplayName) 
| extend UPN_ = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].UPN)
| where UPN_ contains "#EXT#"
| project TimeGenerated, ["Added By"] = UserId, TeamName, DisplayName_, UPN_
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: External Users Added to Team

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where CommunicationType == "Team"
| where Operation == "MemberRemoved"
| extend DisplayName_ = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].DisplayName) 
| extend UPN_ = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].UPN)
| where UPN_ contains "#EXT#"
| project TimeGenerated, ["Removed By"] = UserId, TeamName, DisplayName_, UPN_
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: External Users Removed from the Team

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where UserId contains "#EXT#"
| project TimeGenerated, Operation, UserId
| sort by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: External Users Activity

content.query:
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where UserId contains "#EXT#"
| summarize count() by Operation, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
content.title: External Activity, by Day

content.query:
// If you want to look at user added further than 7 days ago adjust this value 
let time_ago = 7d; 
// If you want to change the timeframe of how quickly accounts need to be added and removed change this value 
let time_delta = 1h; 
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(time_ago) 
| where Operation =~ "MemberAdded" 
| extend UPN = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].UPN) 
| where UPN contains "#EXT#"
| project TimeAdded=TimeGenerated, Operation, UPN, UserWhoAdded = UserId, TeamName, TeamGuid
| join ( 
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(time_ago) 
| where Operation =~ "MemberRemoved" 
| extend UPN = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].UPN) 
| where UPN contains "#EXT#"
| project TimeDeleted=TimeGenerated, Operation, UPN, UserWhoDeleted = UserId, TeamName, TeamGuid) on UPN, TeamGuid 
| where TimeDeleted < (TimeAdded + time_delta) 
| project TimeAdded, TimeDeleted, UPN, UserWhoAdded, UserWhoDeleted, TeamName, TeamGuid 
// Uncomment the following line to map query entities is you plan to use this as a detection query 
| extend timestamp = TimeAdded, AccountCustomEntity = UPN
content.title: External Users Added and Removed
Multiple Teams Deleted by a single user

content.query:
let timeFrame = 1d;
let logonDiff = 10m;
SigninLogs 
  | where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeFrame) 
  | where ResultType == "0" 
  | where AppDisplayName startswith "Microsoft Teams"
  | project SuccessLogonTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, SuccessIPAddress = IPAddress, AppDisplayName, SuccessIPBlock = strcat(split(IPAddress, ".")[0], ".", split(IPAddress, ".")[1])
  | join kind= inner (
      SigninLogs 
      | where TimeGenerated >= ago(timeFrame) 
      | where ResultType !in ("0", "50140") 
      | where ResultDescription !~ "Other"  
      | where AppDisplayName startswith "Microsoft Teams"
      | project FailedLogonTime = TimeGenerated, UserPrincipalName, FailedIPAddress = IPAddress, AppDisplayName, ResultType, ResultDescription
  ) on UserPrincipalName, AppDisplayName 
  | where SuccessLogonTime < FailedLogonTime and FailedLogonTime - SuccessLogonTime <= logonDiff and FailedIPAddress !startswith SuccessIPBlock
  | summarize FailedLogonTime = max(FailedLogonTime), SuccessLogonTime = max(SuccessLogonTime) by UserPrincipalName, SuccessIPAddress, AppDisplayName, FailedIPAddress, ResultType, ResultDescription 
  | extend timestamp = SuccessLogonTime, AccountCustomEntity = UserPrincipalName, IPCustomEntity = SuccessIPAddress
content.title: Successful logon from IP and failure from a different IP (Teams Signins)

content.query:
// Adjust this value to change how many teams a user is made owner of before detecting 
let max_owner_count = 3; 
// Change this value to adjust how larger timeframe the query is run over. 
let time_window = 1d; 
let high_owner_count = (OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams" 
| where TimeGenerated > ago(time_window) 
| where Operation =~ "MemberRoleChanged" 
| extend Member = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].UPN)  
| extend NewRole = toint(parse_json(Members)[0].Role)  
| where NewRole == 2 
| summarize dcount(TeamName) by Member 
| where dcount_TeamName > max_owner_count 
| project Member); 
OfficeActivity
| where OfficeWorkload == "MicrosoftTeams"
| where TimeGenerated > ago(time_window) 
| where Operation =~ "MemberRoleChanged" 
| extend Member = tostring(parse_json(Members)[0].UPN)  
| extend NewRole = toint(parse_json(Members)[0].Role)  
| where NewRole == 2 
| where Member in (high_owner_count)
content.title: User is made owner

content.query:
let suspiciousExtensions = dynamic(['exe', 'msi', 'bin', 'dll']);
OfficeActivity 
| where RecordType =~ "SharePointFileOperation" 
| where UserId !~ "app@sharepoint"
| where SourceRelativeUrl has "Microsoft Teams Chat Files" 
| where Operation =~ "FileUploaded" 
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, Site_Url, OfficeObjectId, SourceFileName, SourceFileExtension
| where SourceFileExtension has_any(suspiciousExtensions)
content.title: Sharing - Suspicious FIle Extensions
Anomalous login followed by Teams action
